sections.title: Education Policy Research Practicum
sections.description: This course will partner students with educational leaders to conduct client-based, applied education research projects. Students will engage in original empirical analysis, learning how to use empirical evidence to support the work of policymakers and practitioners, and will complete written policy reports and present their findings to clients.

sections.title: Education Policy Research Practicum
sections.description: This course requires students to demonstrate skills and knowledge of education policy through applied research projects. Students will conduct original empirical analyses, synthesize existing empirical evidence for policy audiences, and present findings from their work. The goal is to prepare students for meaningful careers in policy.
